caption: 🏆 Every Qatar Grand Prix winner: 2021 Hamilton (Mercedes), then Verstappen (Red Bull) in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

📐 2023: third title sealed in the Saturday Sprint. 2024: started P2 after a one place grid penalty. 2025: won by 7.995 s after McLaren stayed out under the lap 7 safety car. Sources: FIA, formula1.com, Motorsport Magazine.

scenes.say: One driver has won every Qatar Grand Prix since twenty twenty three.

headline: Qatar GP
winners
scenes.say: Lewis Hamilton won the first one in twenty twenty one. Max Verstappen has won all three since.
In twenty twenty three he sealed his third title in the Saturday sprint, then won on Sunday.
In twenty twenty four a one place grid penalty took his pole. He led into turn one anyway.
In twenty twenty five, McLaren stayed out under the lap seven safety car. Verstappen won by seven point nine nine five seconds.
